summary.stack: e2e/run-local.sh (production profile, PostgreSQL, RLS role modocument_app)

scenarios.name: Platform admin 1 approves own BANK_CREATE
Bank B ADMIN reads bank A private template
Bank B ADMIN reads bank A bank-shared template
Bank B ADMIN reads bank A ingestion job
Bank B ADMIN exports bank A ingestion job
Bank B ADMIN uses bank A template for an upload
Bank A ADMIN reads READ_WRITE user's private template
Bank A ADMIN reads READ_WRITE user's ingestion job
Bank A READ_ONLY reads READ_WRITE user's ingestion job
PLATFORM_ADMIN reads bank A template
PLATFORM_ADMIN reads bank A ingestion job

scenarios.name: ADMIN submits a role change
Same ADMIN approves own role change
APPROVER (different user) rejects it
ADMIN requests a change of own role
Bank ADMIN creates a PLATFORM_ADMIN user
scenarios.detail: {"error":"Unknown role 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'; use ADMIN, APPROVER, READ_WRITE or READ_ONLY.","requestId":"01a1550c-e145-7b71-b08d-abae8d16cc0f"}

scenarios.name: READ_WRITE submits USER_CREATE through the generic queue
Author (ADMIN) releases own submitted document
Bank B ADMIN reads bank A document
Bank B ADMIN releases bank A document
APPROVER (not the author) releases it
READ_WRITE runs a CSV with synthetic NIC/phone/name to VALIDATED on a bank-shared template
READ_WRITE (owner) searches the bank-shared template's records
APPROVER (colleague) searches the bank-shared template's records
ADMIN (colleague) searches the bank-shared template's records
READ_ONLY (colleague) searches the bank-shared template's records
ADMIN (bank B) searches the bank-shared template's records
PLATFORM_ADMIN searches the bank-shared template's records
READ_WRITE (owner) exports the job as CSV
Role change applies only after a second admin approves; old token dies
scenarios.expected: pending 202, token 200 before, 401 after, new role after sign-in

scenarios.name: Disabled account is inert the moment the approval lands
ADMIN exports the user list with last-login dates (CSV)
Access-review worksheet lists every bank A account with inactive90d
